expects.query: Autonomously build, but do not deploy, a VSS stack under `_builds/alerts-cv-lvs-subtitle/` on this two-GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell host. Use the Alerts verification profile (`MODE=2d_cv`) as the Foundation, add video summarization (LVS), and retain the Web UI. Use no agent harness. Generate and validate the build artifacts without starting containers.
checks: The final `COMPOSE_PROFILES` includes `alert-bridge`, `perception-alerts`, `vss-behavior-analytics-alerts`, `lvs-server`, and `vss-ui`, so CV verification, summarization, and the UI are enabled.
`override.env` sets `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_SUBTITLE="Vision (Alerts - CV + LVS)"`; it includes the CV alert label and LVS exactly once each.
The resolved `vss-ui` service receives `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_SUBTITLE` with the exact value `Vision (Alerts - CV + LVS)`.
